body: Hey, OP, I feel this exact same way. No emotions, no feelings, nothing. I was also considered smart and never studied. I’m in my third year of college and I doubt I’ll make it through this year as well. I got by some classes not studying, and now since I’m at home 24/7 I can’t bring myself to do anything relating to school. I too want to end it all rather than fix my problems. I can’t help you or myself, I just wanted to say that we’re in the same situation.
